trailhead.label: Katharinaberg village centre, free car park, bus 261 stop Katharinaberg (official start)

cautions: About 3.8 km on the narrow Sonnenberg mountain road (route 10A), open to cars.
Two short steep, narrow path stretches (about 0.5 m wide) at km 1.6–2.0 and 6.1–6.3.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Two short steep, narrow path stretches (: Due brevi tratti di sentiero ripidi e stretti (larghi circa 0,5 m) tra il km 1,6 e il 2,0 e tra il km 6,1 e il 6,3.
